sections.Profile:
The Magic pinball machine, released by Stern Electronics in August 1979, is a solid-state game featuring a fantasy theme. Designed by Mike Kubin with artwork by Bob Timm, this machine was part of Stern’s early foray into solid-state technology, utilizing the Stern M-100 MPU system.

- Manufacturer: Stern Electronics
- Years made: 1979
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 4
- Tags: Magic, Fairy, Skulls, Stern Electronics, 1970s, Solid State, Dragons, Fantasy
sections.Design Team:
- Art: Bob Timm
- Design: Mike Kubin
